tool.name: LibreQDA
tool.description: Qualitative data analysis: import documents, highlight and tag excerpts, export
tool.help:
`LibreQDA <https://gitlab.com/bin-cirst/libreqda/libre-qda>`_ is a free and open-source qualitative data analysis (QDA) tool developed by the Plateforme en humanités numériques (PHuN) at Université de Sherbrooke. It is a fork of `Taguette <https://taguette.org/>`_ with additions developed together with qualitative-analysis researchers: document collections, code hierarchies, overlaid coding stripes, drag-and-drop coding, an integrated search engine and faster multi-file import.
.. class:: infomark
**This is the plain application, running inside Galaxy.** The tool has no inputs and no outputs for now: the session starts with an empty project and you import your documents (PDF, DOCX, ODT, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI, RTF) from the browser. Anything you download from the application (tagged excerpts, coded documents, exports for diffusion or post-processing) is saved through your browser as usual - it does not go to your Galaxy history yet.
.. class:: warning
The project database lives inside the interactive session. When the session ends, the session's data is gone - export your work from the application before stopping it.
Citation: LibreQDA has no software paper yet; please cite the software via its repository (see citation) and mention the version used.
